baselines.loraret: the per-task LoRA of the nearest OTHER held-out task by demo distance, no training (adapter library + retrieval)
planned_trained: equal-bytes adapter (rank 2 on the last two layers, 258 KB, trained on the whole demo, always on)
full fine-tuning of the action expert
stream: sequential LoRA, sequential LoRA + replay, multitask LoRA
baselines.promptret: the prior under the instruction of the training task that owns most of the demo's nearest library chunks (r14)
baselines.vinn: VINN: nearest demo frame by ImageNet ResNet-18 features of both cameras, that frame's demo chunk

metrics.comparisons: borrowing + 258 KB fold (the pre-registered method) against each baseline, paired on init states 30-49 of the 21 tasks the prior fails; superiority by the sign test, and the pooled difference with the two-level cluster bootstrap
metrics.note: choices of the retrieval baselines are fixed from the demo before any rollout (ledger r14_retrieval)
